title: Bratty Woman Claims Cop Raped Her During Transport
description:
This woman just hit a man with a wine glass and tried to set a lady's hair on fire. She was very clearly trying to play the victim. Even the officers were unprepared for what was coming. Watch how she tries to frame the officer for sexual harassment. The woman swore in her statement that the officer had tried to rape her. She was charged with aggravated battery, aggravated assault, resisting officer, battery upon a peace officer, battery and falsely accusing an officer with sexual harassment.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
